subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google presents Vertex AI under Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but the reported wording is not the exact official wording I found and broad renames could break provider/config compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave existing copy until Google’s SDK/API and OpenClaw docs intentionally move away from Vertex AI naming.

options.title: Use Short Gemini Enterprise Copy
options.body: Adopt a shorter UI label but document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex API/ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the clearest recent ownership signal across the current label snapshot and adjacent Google plugin onboarding metadata.
